system: Zhou royal reign years (Warring States frame)
conversion_rule: reign year n of a Zhou king = the line the Shiji's Chronological Table of the Six States (Shiji 15, 六國年表) prints against it; the table sets Zhou, Qin, Wei, Han, Zhao, Chu, Yan and Qi side by side, one column each, one line per year
note: Added r5-3 (2026-09-20) for the Warring States events read in Shiji 15. The table's own frame is the reign-year columns: its first data line names each column's ruler (周元王元年。/ 秦厲共公元年。/ 魏獻子。/ 韓宣子 / 趙簡子。四十二。/ 楚惠王章十三年。/ 燕獻公十七年。/ 齊平公驁五年。), and accessions are printed in the cells as they fall (定王元年 at the line the edition labels 468; 威烈王元年 at 425; 魏文侯斯元年 at 424; 韓景侯虔元年 and 趙烈侯籍元年 at 408). THE BCE COLUMN IS THE EDITION'S, NOT SIMA QIAN'S: the leftmost column of the ctext edition (https://ctext.org/shiji/liu-guo-nian-biao, read 2026-09-20, this session) supplies the western years, and rows citing this calendar say so. year_start was not established from the source read for this row and is deliberately blank; CAL_LU records the Zhou first month as c. Dec-Jan for the Lu ducal years.
